question: Should the Auto QA skill require clean canonical-checkout verification and independently observed live-worker/provider evidence as mandatory campaign acceptance gates?
rationale: The patch is documentation-only and technically coherent, but it deliberately changes the operational threshold for what maintainers may count as verified campaign evidence.

options.title: Approve the stricter evidence contract
options.body: Merge the focused documentation update and require future campaigns to reject unverifiable source, worker, provider, and browser evidence.

options.title: Narrow the mandatory gates
options.body: Keep only the evidence requirements that the team can consistently collect, and revise the skill before merge to distinguish required from advisory checks.

recommendation.title: Approve the stricter evidence contract
recommendation.body: Merge the focused documentation update and require future campaigns to reject unverifiable source, worker, provider, and browser evidence.
